name: What are common problems to avoid during bathroom floor tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What are common problems to avoid during bathroom floor tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common problems to avoid during bathroom floor tile installation include inadequate subfloor preparation, improper mortar mixing or application, uneven tile setting, and rushing the drying or curing process. Issues like an unlevel subfloor can lead to cracked tiles, while insufficient mortar can result in hollow spots and tile failure. Hometelligent Inc. advises against cutting corners on prep work, as this often leads to costly repairs later. Ensuring proper expansion joints are left around the perimeter can also prevent future cracking due due to temperature changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid inadequate subfloor prep, improper mortar use, uneven tile setting, and rushing curing. These can lead to cracked tiles or tile failure.
